PUFF_COUNT.description: How many cloud puffs are generated per grid cell.

PUFF_MIN_SIZE.description: Smallest possible puff radius, in blocks.

PUFF_MAX_SIZE.description: Largest possible puff radius, in blocks.

PUFF_HEIGHT_FACTOR.description: Puff height as a fraction of its radius. Lower values give flat, pancake-like puffs; higher values give tall, column-like puffs.

COMPACT_MODE.description: If enabled, puffs cluster into denser clumps. If disabled, puffs scatter freely and spill across cell edges to hide seams.

CLUSTER_MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum number of clumps per cell. Only used when Compact Mode is enabled.

CLUSTER_JITTER_FRACTION.description: How far puffs can drift from their clump's center, as a fraction of the cell size. Only used when Compact Mode is enabled.

SCATTER_OVERLAP_FACTOR.description: How far puffs can spill past a cell's edge, relative to their own size. Only used when Compact Mode is disabled.

NOISE_HEIGHT_ENABLED.description: If enabled, cloud height rolls smoothly across the map. If disabled, the whole layer sits at one flat height.

NOISE_HEIGHT_SCALE.description: How quickly cloud height changes across space. Lower values give broad, rolling shapes; higher values give choppy, frequent variation.

NOISE_HEIGHT_SEED.description: Seed for the height pattern. Different seeds give different terrain shapes without changing their overall character.
